CHAIRPERSON MANALO

  VICE CHAIR DIAZ | COMMISSIONER FONSECA

  CITY OF ARTESIA
  REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING

  TUESDAY, JULY 18, 2023 | 7:00 p.m.

  PRIMARY LOCATION

  City Council Chambers of Artesia City Hall
  18747 Clarkdale Avenue
  (562) 865-6262

  REMOTE TELECONFERENCE LOCATION
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54953
  (Commissioner Bacolod)

  Business Center
  26000 Mill Creek Avenue
  Alpharetta, GA 30022

  AGENDA ITEMS
1.  Call to Order

2.  Invocation

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

4.  Roll Call of Commission

5.  Approval of Agenda

6.  Announcement of Speaker Slips

  For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item
  on the agenda, please complete a Speaker Slip located in the lobby or at the
  podium and deposit it with the Community Development Director prior to the
  commencement of the meeting. Under California law, public comments at special
  meetings are limited to subjects on the agenda, only. Please note that there is a
  five-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this time limit.

7.  Public Comments for Items Not on the Agenda

  1
 8.  New Business – Public Hearings (Continued)

  A. Case No. 2023-07 - A REQUEST FOR APPROVAL OF THE ABOVE CASE
  WITH THE FOLLOWING COMPONENTS: (1) A DESIGN REVIEW
  APPROVAL TO CONVERT AN EXISTING ONE-STORY, 6,480 SQUARE
  FOOT COMMERCIAL BUILDING (CURRENTLY AN AUTO BODY REPAIR
  SHOP) INTO A RETAIL JEWELRY STORE (MALABAR GOLD AND
  DIAMONDS). THE REMODEL INCLUDES EXTERIOR AND INTERIOR
  IMPROVEMENTS TO THE BUILDING, PARKING AREA, AND LANDSCAPE
  AREAS. (2) ALSO PROPOSED IS A SIGN PROGRAM THAT WILL INCLUDE
  NEW EXTERIOR ILLUMINATED SIGNAGE AND A SIGN FACE CHANGE TO
  THE EXISTING POLE SIGN. THE SITE IS LOCATED AT 18702 PIONEER
  BLVD. IN THE C-G (COMMERCIAL GENERAL) ZONE

  Recommended Action:

  1. Open and conduct a public hearing;

  2. Find that the proposed project is Categorically Exempt (Class 1) from State
  CEQA Guidelines Section 15301of the CEQA Guidelines; and

  3. Adopt Resolution 2023-03P: A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING
  COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA APPROVING APPLICATION 2023-
  07 FOR (1) A DESIGN REVIEW TO CONVERT AN EXISTING ONE-STORY,
  6,480 SQUARE FOOT COMMERCIAL BUILDING (CURRENTLY AN AUTO
  BODY REPAIR SHOP) INTO A RETAIL JEWELRY STORE (MALABAR GOLD
  AND DIAMONDS). (2) A SIGN PROGRAM THAT WILL INCLUDE NEW
  EXTERIOR ILLUMINATED SIGNAGE AND A SIGN FACE CHANGE TO THE
  EXISTING POLE SIGN. THE SITE IS LOCATED AT 18702 PIONEER BLVD.
  IN THE C-G (COMMERCIAL GENERAL) ZONE
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

9.  New Business – Public Hearings (Regular) (None)

10.  New Business – Non-Public Hearing (None)

11.  Discussion/Report Items from Staff (None)

12.  Items from the Commission

  a. Discussion regarding projects modified after Planning Commission
  approval.

  b. Discussion regarding the City’s graffiti removal process and efforts.

  2
 13.  Adjournment to the Regular Planning Commission Meeting to be held on
  Tuesday, August 15, 2023, at 7:00 p.m., in the City Council Chambers of
  Artesia City Hall at 18747 Clarkdale Avenue, Artesia.
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please contact
the Planning Department at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
